title: fix(app-shell): the flow designer's Cron schedule field reads every cadence form the engine runs (objectui#12779)
body:
Fixes #12779
Clause-②: no

## What changed
The flow designer's start-node **Cron schedule** field now reads every cadence form the engine runs, instead of reading empty over a schedule that runs.

- `normalizeScheduleCadence` (in `flow-node-config.ts`) mirrors the engine's `normalizeSchedule` (objectstack `packages/triggers/trigger-schedule/src/schedule-trigger.ts`, read at objectstack `570c7a2d95`). It is mirrored, not imported: no new dependency on a trigger package. `getFieldValue` reads the field through it, so a bare cron string, `{ expression }` and `{ cron }`, typed or untyped, all show their cron.
- An interval or once cadence is drawn read-only as what it is, for example "Every 1 min" for the showcase's `{ type: 'interval', intervalMs: 60000 }` or "Once, at …". The label is "Schedule", and one line says the designer edits cron schedules only. It reuses the inspector's existing `disabled` control, the one read-only flows already use. No interval or once editor is added, and a stored interval is never converted to a cron.
- A commit rewrites `config.schedule` through `scheduleWithExpression`, so the stored descriptor resolves to the cron the field shows. A bare string stays a bare string. A stale `cron` key is replaced. An object keeps its `type` and `timezone`. The flat `config.cron` migrate-on-edit is unchanged.
- zh copy for the 8 new designer-table keys; one changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Why
The field read only `config.schedule.expression` or the flat `config.cron`. A bare string (app-todo's `task_reminder`), a `{ cron }` cadence and an interval (the showcase's `showcase_scheduled_digest`) all read empty, so an admin could "fix" a working flow. Typing a cron over an interval merged `expression` beside `type: 'interval'`, which the engine ignores.

## Evidence
- Tests: `flow-node-config.scheduleCadence-12779.test.ts` (the engine's form table, reads, writes, controls) and `FlowNodeInspector.scheduleCadence-12779.test.tsx` (rendered reads, the read-only interval and once readings, writes, controls). Three ablations each turned the targeted cases red: read 11, read-only 11, write 3. Each file was restored to its HEAD blob.
- Run at ce4b59b: app-shell dependency build, `type-check`, and 154 test files (2585 passed); i18n, changeset, citation and spec-symbol gates all exit 0.
- Live, against a published-package backend (`@objectstack/cli` 18.0.0-next.2): before, both the showcase interval node and a bare-string node read an empty Cron schedule. After, they read "Every 1 min" (read-only) and "0 8 * * *". Screenshots are on branch `claude/issue-12779-evidence` under `evidence/12779/`. The bare-string flow was added to the backend's scratch copy only.

## Acceptance notes
- The canvas summary (`FlowCanvas.tsx`, outside this change) shows a bare string's cron but no cadence for an interval or once node.
- The Trigger select and the flow header still label an interval flow "Schedule (cron)". This is reported separately, not changed here.
- On a non-cron cadence that is also flagged "kept, not in effect", the clear button is disabled together with the read-only control.
